title: Protocol for Preparing Seagrass-Microbiome Samples for DNA Extraction
author: Cassie Ettinger
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.butqnwmw

steps.title: Prepare balance and weigh samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the balance and weigh the samples to standardize amounts or for quantitative PCR.

substeps.instruction: Clean the balance with 70% ethanol solution.
Place a sterile weigh boat on the balance and tare.
Place the sample in the weigh boat using sterile forceps or scoopulas.
Record the sample weight (e.g., approximately 250 mg for sediment).

steps.title: Sterilize tools between samples
steps.instruction: Flame sterilize forceps or scoopulas between each sample using the following sequence.

substeps.instruction: Immerse in 10% bleach (0.5% NaOCl).
Immerse in water.
Immerse in ethanol.
Flame sterilize.

steps.title: Allocate samples to tubes
steps.instruction: Place samples into the appropriate tubes based on tissue type.

substeps.instruction: Place sediment directly into DNA extraction tubes.
Place other tissues (roots, leaves, rhizomes) into tubes for washing, or directly into DNA extraction tubes if epiphyte washes and surface sterilization are not required.

steps.title: Perform epiphyte wash
steps.instruction: Extract epiphytes using a modified Redford buffer solution.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 1:50 dilution (in autoclaved H2O) of Redford buffer solution [1 M Tris-HCL, 0.5 M NaEDTA, 1.2% Triton-X (replacing Ctab)].
Add 500 µL of the diluted buffer to samples.
Vortex/agitate for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 4000 x g for 20 minutes to pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in MoBio solution C1 (or equivalent) and proceed with DNA extraction.

steps.title: Surface-sterilize plant tissues
steps.instruction: Clean the surface of plant tissues if epiphytes are not wanted or after the epiphyte wash is complete.

substeps.instruction: Rinse tissue with autoclaved H2O.
Immerse tissue in 0.5% NaOCl (~10% bleach) for 2 minutes.
Rinse with autoclaved H2O for 1 minute.
Repeat the H2O rinse until the tissue has been rinsed three times.

steps.title: Crush tissue for extraction
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt the sterilized tissue to prepare for DNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Crush tissue using a sterile centrifuge pestle.
For hardy plant tissues, use a sterilized electric drill with the centrifuge pestle as a drill bit (ensure the drill is cleaned between samples).
